statement: Isomorphism of the free group factors. Resolves the free group factor isomorphism problem: $`L(\mathbb F_2)\cong L(\mathbb F_3)`$, and hence all interpolated free group factors, including $`L(\mathbb F_\infty)`$, are isomorphic. Their common factor has fundamental group $`\mathbb R_{\gt 0}`$.
